scripts.install:all: bun install && (cd apps/frontend && bun install) && (cd apps/backend && bun install)
scripts.clean:all: rm -rf node_modules bun.lock apps/*/node_modules apps/*/bun.lock apps/*/dist apps/*/coverage apps/*/documentation apps/frontend/.angular
scripts.reset:all: bun run clean:all && bun run install:all
scripts.docker:up:build: bun run docker:build && docker compose up --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:up:build:no-cache: bun run docker:build:no-cache && docker compose up --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:clean: docker compose down --remove-orphans && docker system prune --all --volumes --force && docker builder prune --all --force
scripts.docker:clean:volumes: docker compose down --remove-orphans --volumes && docker system prune --all --volumes --force && docker builder prune --all --force
